title: Duplicates with a set
hints: A set is a map whose keys are the elements. `seen := map[int]bool{}`; reading a missing key gives `false`, so `if seen[n]` is a membership test.
`HasDuplicate`: in the loop, `if seen[n] { return true }`, then `seen[n] = true`. After the loop, `return false`.
`Dedupe`: `seen := map[string]struct{}{}` and `var out []string`. For each `w`: `if _, ok := seen[w]; ok { continue }`, then `seen[w] = struct{}{}` and `out = append(out, w)`.
